name: Smiilen — short-form food video → delivery orders
summary: Smiilen is a video-first food delivery marketplace: creators/diners post food clips → one-tap checkout → Smiilen delivers; restaurants pay on performance; creators earn commissions. Adjacent to BiteSight (TikTok-meets-DoorDash class). Sharpens Never86 first-party Shop buy-now vs another marketplace with UGC discovery. Not fee dogfood.
not_this: Not first-party Shop. Not fee dogfood. Not forecasting.
